historical_cpu_profiling.scope: 1000 MQTT5 TLS telemetry64, historical successful CI, not candidate or 10K acceptance

baseline_smoke.reason: harness validation while other review work may still be active

environment_failure.cause: workspace sandbox denied the owned loopback bind

candidate_builds.reason: preliminary build predates the final deadline race fixes

candidate_builds.status: used for all completed 24 matched 10K density measurements, seven large-wire cases and independent cleanup/profiling probes

density_original_campaign.invalid_cause: 3668 load-generator EADDRNOTAVAIL errors, only 6332 actual TCP connections; not normalized as 10K
density_original_campaign.method_revision: repeat full TCP two-round matched case with natural cooldown after read-only MSL check; preserve original successful baseline and invalid candidate as diagnostic evidence

candidate_linux_profiling.scope: 1000 actual MQTT5 TLS telemetry64 clients, 60-second CPU workload, 30-second heap workload, both native jobs complete, not 10K lock-contention proof

large_wire_method_revisions.status: Both MQTT 3.1.1 ACK/delivery workloads completed, but cleanup task gate invalid: cold startup 6 versus post-HTTP-request 8; retained, excluded from valid matched comparisons.
large_wire_method_revisions.observed_owner_inference: First HTTP1 pool connection driver and idle interval fit source and single max-active sink connection; no actual task stack attribution.

large_wire_method_revisions.status: complete; all seven valid; six normal cases with one excluded prewarm event each and one intentional partial-frame case without prewarm
large_wire_method_revisions.prewarm: Exactly one owned 256-byte event and its sink ACK occur before measured load; warmed baseline requires zero online/pending and three consecutive identical task counts; no hardcoded expected increment.

full_ready_auth_isolated_proof.scope: Mixed complete auth functions under the identical candidate Reader/runtime, one full 8-byte prefill with no quota/grow/listener; not a complete baseline build.

native_10k_sampling.scope: Independent one-tenant wall-clock thread sampling, not matched CPU A/B; actual online population 10000 verified at each start.
native_10k_sampling.interpretation: Observed quota and mutex-wait frames do not measure lock hold time or establish a CPU bottleneck; no lock rewrite is made.

exit_evidence.server_note: Server waited and reaped; its exit code is not exported by the memory harness.

native_10k_sampling.latency_counter_scope: Full approximately 40-second loadgen run, not the configured ten-second stack capture.
native_10k_sampling.sampler_observation_scope: Observed wait/finish timestamps may include delay after capture; configured duration and tool header are separate evidence, not observed sampling wall time.
native_10k_sampling.symbol_counts_scope: Only Call graph lines before Total number in stack, excluding duplicated aggregation tables; corrected without rerunning raw sampling.
native_10k_sampling.prior_derived_summary_classification: Processing scope error in aggregation tables, not a load failure.

large_prefix_disconnect.initial_attempt: Invalid fixture credential representation caused auth EOF. It is retained separately and is not a product failure or a valid memory measurement.
large_prefix_disconnect.limits: Original server defaults; no runtime limits overridden. No server configuration, credentials or binary spool data are published.
large_prefix_disconnect.interpretation: Process-wide requested heap includes other ownership and retained auth cache. Private global/tenant balances remain unexported.

perf_cpu_reporting_fix.before: 2 real-main mock tests fail because load CPU delta is absent
perf_cpu_reporting_fix.after: 2 tests pass: CPU 100 -> 105 gives load delta 5, while legacy cumulative 108 is preserved
perf_cpu_reporting_fix.scope: Loadgen lifecycle including ramp/warmup/cooldown; before optional profiler-tail waiting, metrics and shutdown; not the configured publication-only duration.
perf_cpu_reporting_fix.historical_measurements: Previously measured large-wire JSON remains cumulative. New fields are not retroactively inserted.
perf_cpu_reporting_fix.initial_setup_failure: Missing copied shared Python dependency; retained separately, corrected before defect reproduction.

profiler_exception_cleanup.before: Interim new-delta script: 2 existing CPU cases pass; profiler error cleanup case fails (profiler still running).
profiler_exception_cleanup.after: Same three main tests pass; failed CPU read propagates and owned profiler is killed and reaped.

live_functional_smoke.interpretation: CPU snapshot resolution yielded zero delta; this does not mean no CPU was used. Functional field test only, not matched A/B or capacity.

perf_cpu_reporting_fix.cleanup_timeout_behavior: Each known child is attempted independently; first OSError/TimeoutExpired propagates after remaining owners are attempted. Timed-out profiler reaping stays unconfirmed, rather than claiming all children succeeded.

completion_checks_before_profiler_owner_.scope: Python snapshot predates the final profiler-failure owner repair; Rust code is unchanged.

original_parser_fuzz_raw_availability.previous_independent_hash_checks: All three matched their historical manifest hashes in multiple earlier checks during this review.

final_evidence_integrity.git_diff_check_scope: Staged source, both reports and evidence-tools pass; the full staged archive reports preserved log whitespace, patch context and CSV CRLF endings. The earlier clean unstaged check excluded untracked evidence.
